hook: NINE SODAS A DAY. THAT WAS IT.
yt_title: How Coca-Cola Started: Nine Drinks A Day #Shorts
desc: Coca-Cola began in Atlanta in 1886, when it sold for five cents a glass at a soda fountain. Sales averaged only about nine drinks a day in year one. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: A global drink that started with nine glasses a day! 🥤 Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a soda fan! Comment YES if you knew

lines.text: How did Coca-Cola start? With just nine drinks a day.
It was eighteen eighty-six in Atlanta, Georgia.
A pharmacist named John Pemberton mixed the syrup.
A glass cost five cents at a local soda fountain counter.
Today it is sold in over two hundred countries. Not bad for nine glasses a day.

v.t: FROM NINE A DAY TO THE WORLD
